summary: Iteration 6 — Sprint 2 Pro monetization (real gating + Claude Sonnet 4.5 AI recs + advanced stats + 50-item library cap). NEW backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_sprint2_pro.py → 18/18 PASS (100%). All spec items verified: (1) GET /api/limits — admin Pro returns {tier:'pro', library:{used, cap:null, remaining:null}}; fresh free user returns {tier:'free', library:{used:0, cap:50, remaining:50}}; no-auth → 401. (2) Library cap enforcement — fast-forwarded free user to 50 library docs via direct mongo insert, attempted 51st via POST /api/library → HTTP 402 with detail.code='library_cap_reached', detail.cap=50; UPDATE of one of the 50 existing items (status change to 'watching') succeeded (200) and persisted; admin (Pro) has cap=null. (3) GET /api/stats/advanced — free user → 402 'Pro subscription required'; admin Pro → 200 with ALL required keys (total_episodes_watched, estimated_hours, estimated_days, top_series, top_genres, heatmap, library_breakdown, top_months, library_size); no-auth → 401. (4) POST /api/ai/recommendations — free user → 402; no-auth → 401; admin Pro → 200 with 5 recommendations (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent Universal Key), model='claude-sonnet-4-5', each rec has {tmdb_id, name, ai_why, in_library, poster_url, first_air_date, vote_average}; response time ~8-12s (< 60s ceiling). (5) Regression smoke — /auth/me, /library, /billing/plans, /billing/me, /notifications, /calendar/upcoming all 200. FRONTEND E2E verified on preview URL: ADMIN (Pro) — /stats shows stats-big-numbers (13 eps/9.8 hrs/0.41 dias/7 séries), stats-heatmap with 371 grid cells + 5 legend cells = 376 total (matches spec 53×7=371), stats-top-genres (Action, Drama, Sci-Fi, etc.), stats-top-series; /ai-recommendations shows 5 ai-rec-{0..4} cards with poster + title + ai_why block + ai-add-{tmdb_id} 'Quero assistir' buttons (5/5 present since admin library is small); ai-regenerate-btn visible; nav-ai-link + nav-stats-link visible in AppLayout nav. FRESH FREE user (TEST_fe_*) — /ai-recommendations shows ai-paywall + ai-paywall-cta with href='/pricing' (no ai-recs-list); /stats shows stats-paywall + stats-paywall-cta (no stats-big-numbers); nav-ai-link + nav-stats-link still visible for Free (clicks go to paywalls as spec requires). Admin Pro state restored + all TEST_* users/library rows cleaned up post-test.

Not a bug, just a shape assumption change — flag to main agent in case frontend /pricing reads a different shape than what billing returns.

action_items: (Informational) Confirm /api/billing/plans response shape — tests now expect {plans:[{id,amount,currency,days,...}]}. If frontend /pricing consumes a different shape, align either server or client.

(Carry-over from iter-5 — not tested this iteration) streaming regression: restore providers/matched_providers on episode objects + tighten _provider_matches for Apple TV+ vs 'Apple TV Amazon Channel'.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: require_pro dependency correctly uses is_pro() which validates tier==pro AND subscription_renews_at > now — prevents stale 'pro' flag after expiry.
GOOD: POST /library cap check correctly allows UPDATE of existing items (existing_in_lib short-circuit) while blocking new adds — matches spec exactly.
GOOD: /api/ai/recommendations enriches LLM output with TMDB posters in parallel (asyncio.gather) and sets in_library flag by diff with current library — no N+1 sync loops.
GOOD: /api/stats/advanced parallelizes genre fetches via asyncio.gather over library[:50]; capped at 50 TMDB calls so won't runaway on huge libraries.

MINOR: /api/ai/recommendations LLM response takes 8-12s on average — no caching. Consider a short user-keyed TTL cache (5-10min) since the prompt is deterministic given library+reviews and LLM calls are expensive.
MINOR: /api/stats/advanced fetches TMDB /tv/{id} for genres with no caching — repeated calls for the same library will re-hit TMDB every time. Add an in-memory LRU (15-30min TTL).
MINOR: server.py is now 1624 lines — still large. Split into routers (billing, pro, streaming, library) is overdue.

MINOR: in ai_recommendations, when LLM returns empty or all enriched items are None, the endpoint returns {'recommendations':[], 'model':'claude-sonnet-4-5'} without signalling WHY to the client — consider adding a 'reason' field like the no_history branch.
